title: Hooks
subtitle: Shell commands Claude Code runs at specific lifecycle events. Use them to gate, log, format, or react to the agent's actions. Stored in `.claude/settings.json` and `.claude/settings.local.json`.
badgeMissing: file does not exist yet — saving will create it
parseErrorBody: Could not parse JSON — fix it manually first, or save here to overwrite (will preserve only the hooks block): {{error}}
rowHelp: Matcher is a regex (or empty for always). Command runs in a shell from the project root. Timeout is in seconds.

scope.projectTooltip: settings.json — shared with your team via git

events.SessionStart: Runs once at the start of a session.
events.UserPromptSubmit: Runs when the user sends a message. Use to add context or refuse.
events.PreToolUse: Runs before any tool the agent calls. Use to gate, log, or prepare.
events.PostToolUse: Runs after a tool succeeds. Use to format, lint, or react to side effects.
events.Notification: Runs when Claude Code wants to surface a notification.
events.Stop: Runs when the agent finishes a turn.
events.SessionEnd: Runs once at the end of a session.
